title: Sketchbook
tagline: Run, drive, and fly around a little island.
blurb: You start as a boxy guy on an island, and within a minute you can hop in a car, a plane, or a helicopter. Pick a race or a ramp from the panel on the right, or just mess around.
desc: Sketchbook by swift502: a third-person sandbox where you run, drive cars, and fly a plane or helicopter around an island. Hosted on kaleerson.com.
author: swift502
tags: sketchbook island sandbox car plane helicopter three.js
extraCredit: Its menu panel asks Google Fonts for three decorative fonts; if that is blocked, the panel just uses a plain font and the game is unaffected.
